_comment: Titan-slayer theme (CLAUDE.md §4.3 decision, 2026-07-27). Cards are DATA (§11). 'starter_deck' = each hunter's opening deck; 'reward_pool' = cards offered between encounters (build step 4 meta-progression). Combo cards target an ally or the Titan to reward coordination (§6): cover/rally help your ally, expose/harpoon set up focus-fire, draw_aggro tanks a telegraphed hit for your ally.

expose.name: Expose
expose.text: Expose: its next 2 hits taken deal +4.

draw_aggro.name: Draw Aggro
draw_aggro.text: Taunt the Titan this round. Gain 6 Block.

harpoon.name: Harpoon
harpoon.text: Deal 8 damage, then Expose the Titan (1).

grip.name: Grip
grip.text: Climb the Titan (+2 Height). Reach a high weak point.

sunlight_blade.name: Sunlight Blade
sunlight_blade.text: Deal 5 damage, +3 for each Exposed stack on the Titan.

bowshot.name: Bowshot
bowshot.text: Deal 3 damage and Expose the Titan (1).

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.text: Gain 2 Strength — your attacks deal +2 for the rest of this fight.

rend.name: Rend
rend.text: Deal 4 damage and apply Wound 2 (the Titan bleeds each turn).

tongue_lash.name: Tongue Lash
tongue_lash.text: Deal 3 damage and pull yourself up (+1 Height).

build_grapple.name: Build Grapple
build_grapple.text: Build a Grappling Hook and add it to your hand.

grapple.name: Grappling Hook
grapple.text: Time it! Climb +1 (+2 nailed) or it slips away.

vine.name: Vine
vine.text: Climb (+1); grow a vine that lifts your ally (+2 Height).

spore.name: Spore Burst
spore.text: Deal 2 damage and Poison 2 (the beast bleeds each turn).

rope_up.name: Rope Up
rope_up.text: You and your ally both climb (+1 Height).

belay_strike.name: Belay Strike
belay_strike.text: Deal 3 damage, +2 for each Height you've climbed.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.text: Time it! 4 dmg (+5 nailed) and hop up +1.

flick.name: Tongue Flick
flick.text: Time it! Flick for 2 (+3 nailed) or it slips away.

lash_out.name: Lash Out
lash_out.text: Time it! 3 (+4 nailed), Poison 2, lift ally +1.

creeper.name: Creeper Vine
creeper.text: Time it! Climb +1 (+2 nailed); ally climbs +1.

piton_drive.name: Piton Drive
piton_drive.text: Time it! 2 dmg, +2 per your Height (+4 nailed).

haul.name: Haul Up
haul.text: Time it! Both climb +1 (you +2 more nailed). Miss and it slips away.

piston_punch.name: Piston Punch
piston_punch.text: Time it! A massive timed blow: 8 (+8 nailed). Miss and it slips away.

goblin_jetpack.name: Goblin Jetpack
goblin_jetpack.text: Prime it — next turn you rocket to the weak point.

grappling_arm.name: Grappling Arm
grappling_arm.text: Pull your ally up to your Height (within 3 below).

build_mech.name: Build Mech
build_mech.text: 2 Block, +2 for each Build Mech played this fight.

burn_coal.name: Burn Coal
burn_coal.text: Sacrifice a card to cut another card's cost by 1 this fight.

catapult.name: Catapult
catapult.text: Sacrifice a card to launch your ally +2 Height.

meld.name: Meld
meld.text: Fuse two cards into one that does both, costing 1 less.

satchel_charge.name: Satchel Charge
satchel_charge.text: Nail 3 timings in a row: detonate for 26. Any miss fizzles.

tongue_snap.name: Tongue Snap
tongue_snap.text: Time it! 2 dmg (+3 nailed), +3 per Rhythm, hop +1.

hop.name: Hop
hop.text: Time it! Hop +1 (+1 nailed), +1 per Rhythm.

leapfrog.name: Leapfrog
leapfrog.text: Spring off the beast: you climb +2 and vault your ally +2.

toxic_lash.name: Toxic Lash
toxic_lash.text: Time it! 2 dmg (+3 nailed), +2 per Poison. Poison 1.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.text: You climb +1; vines haul your ally +3 Height.

blightbloom.name: Blightbloom
blightbloom.text: 1 damage and Poison 3 (it bleeds each turn).

summit_strike.name: Summit Strike
summit_strike.text: Time it! 2 (+3 nailed), +2 per Height of EACH hunter.

belay.name: Belay
belay.text: Anchor your ally: give them 6 Block and climb them +1 Height.

pitons_in.name: Pitons In
pitons_in.text: Hammer pitons: you and your ally both climb +2 Height.
